messages.author: 7e30f494b51d8b2d
messages.subject: Test with phylosig and kmult
parts:
Hello everyone,

I am measuring phylogenetic signal (K) for a multivariate dataset and I tried the phylosig in geomorph and the Kmult function in phylocurve, but I am having trouble interpreting the results. Both K values are the same with both functions, but the null distributions compared against are different. I read and they do randomise different things, so it makes sense that they are different. But could anyone help me interpret what both tests are saying?

My results are: Observed K=0.13, P= 0.03 for geomorph, P=0.04 for phylocurve.  For geomorph the observed K is to the right of the null distribution of Ks and for phylocurve the K is to the left of the null distribution, in this case the null distribution goes from 0.5 to 1.5. 

Thank you very much!
Best,
Iliana

messages.author: 4d71c6e24fb21497
messages.subject: RE: [geomorph-r-package] Test with phylosig and kmult
parts:
Iliana,

 

The reason is that the method in phylocurve uses simulation to generate the empirical sampling distribution. The method in geomorph uses permutation, and is what I originally proposed in my 2014 paper.


Dean
